meaning: The builder-adopted values of one ACTUAL Hermes relay release (hermes-first-call-1). It approves these values for a reviewed code registry entry only. It is not a request, a result or evidence that any provider call ran.

spending.separate_hermes_allocation: none: the builder rejected a separate Hermes sub-cap; the release shares the one USD 2.00 model and data ceiling
spending.ledger_caps: global_cap_usd and owner_cap_usd 2.00 bound liability inside one ledger database only; they do not see spending recorded elsewhere
spending.maximum_reservation_meaning: The worst-case reservation of one request ((65,536 + 64) prompt tokens x 2 + 4,096 completion tokens x 10, USD per million). An accounting calculation, not an allocation.
spending.cache_and_fees: prompt_cache_options is explicit with no breakpoint. A provider cost other than the two-rate charge (cache, reasoning or discount pricing) leaves the whole reservation as UNKNOWN liability.
spending.before_first_actual_call: An external reconciliation of all settled and UNKNOWN model and data liability across ledgers must show remaining room under the USD 2.00 ceiling.

limits: At most one first model request after an accepted registry, a coherent operator configuration, price and ledger, and the remaining-budget reconciliation; no fallback and no blind retry.
The model job holds no provider key; the relay holds it. No key in logs, model context, source control or application responses.
No funded transaction, policy or wallet change, host deployment or main publication is approved by this release.
